lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, showing horizontal alignment across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, forming high-contrast anchor nodes at each intersection point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin displays a high spatial density of small, high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly across its surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, dark-pixel clusters indicative of commensal fish are visible attached to or trailing the ventral and pectoral fin regions.
